objective: Extend ABaKa after A–Z with a protected continuing doctrinal catalog, verified assessments and difficulty-scaled BP rewards without breaking current live paths.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: inspected GitHub main source 9aed7d6ad8b6d0ad80aa71daaf66962e9d49de04 and read-only MAIN DB abc_growth_lesson baseline +8 on 2026-11-24. Neither source HEAD nor a read-only rule check proves actual live OTA. No migration, OTA, or production changes authorized in this DEV PR.
chosenApproach: Keep existing bundled A–Z/legacy completion RPC; add published RLS catalog and separate verified doctrine completion RPC, paginate 80 per page, guard prerequisite and cap on server with ledger idempotency.
selectionRationale: Protect existing A–Z history and offline sync, avoid code update for future doctrine content, and prevent clients overriding point tiers/quiz approvals.
alternativeApproaches: Append thousands of hardcoded A–Z-style lessons and client-computed points (rejected: no administrative publish control, giant bundle, forgeable rewards).
Replace the existing ABC completion RPC and rewrite historical point entries (rejected: high risk to credits, offline sync, and compatibility).
preserveBehaviors: Existing Panimula, preliminary and 26 A–Z lessons retain stable IDs, local answer drafts, account-scoped cached progress, offline completion replay, and server-authoritative credited points.
Legacy point ledger unique keys and historical completed/claimed points are never recalculated or backfilled.
ABaKa detail navigation, Bible reference chips, adjustable font, and no duplicate ads for replayed completions remain supported.
New doctrine cannot mint points offline or bypass a locked prerequisite via direct navigation.
No modification to AdMob rendering, tab performance code, global navigation, or production release identity.
acceptanceChecks: Run Node focus test for published-only catalog, server-owned quiz/points, durable account progress, paginated learning and offline separation.
Run Supabase SQL regression test against isolated staging after applying pending migration; reject any anon catalog read or private answer access.
Verify wrong/correct quiz, reflection rubric, prerequisite, daily cap boundary, midnight rollover, repeat requests, concurrency and claim-state history against staging database.
Reconcile main and approved DEV changes, then run AdMob-first-view, instant dashboard navigation, spacing, source/RC and native-runtime release blockers before OTA.
Never auto-merge, directly mutate MAIN, or claim production release without verified exact deployed artifact and runtime.
